crossRefs.note: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of…
“When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable…
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

translations.web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
translations.bsb: When pride comes, disgrace follows, but with humility comes wisdom.
translations.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
translations.asv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.
